Matches of the Week · GW6
Featured Match

The first loss and the champion

Home
brendog2814
4–1 · 484 pts
vs
Away
erozier
2–3 · 409 pts

brendog2814 was unbeaten until last week, when he posted the lowest score of his season and lost for the first time. He now shares the top of the table instead of owning it. The team waiting for him is the defending champion, who has spent five weeks looking nothing like one and then won by sixty. One of them is coming off his worst week and the other off his most convincing, and the table has them two wins apart. A second defeat here and the early lead is gone entirely.

Featured Match

The co-leader and the newcomer

Home
benditlikebergvall
4–1 · 463 pts
vs
Away
mdropkin
3–2 · 412 pts

benditlikebergvall has quietly drawn level at the top, with four wins and none of the noise that came with the other 4-1 team. Across from him is mdropkin, the league's one new manager, who went four weeks without a bad score and then had the worst one anybody recorded last round. That was either a blip or the start of the season catching up with him, and this is the fixture that says which. A win keeps the newcomer in the leading group; a loss leaves the co-leader clear of it.
